capabilities: Chat about research questions in a side panel
Run Deep Research tasks after reviewing task progress
Inspect evidence and results separately from the conversation
Export completed research results into the vault as Markdown
extras: Manifest warns the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; new users need an invite code to create an account, and the README warns against sending sensitive notes to the cloud service.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to run chat-based research workflows with progress tracking, evidence inspection, and fact checking.

relations.evidence: connects to Deep Research Cloud at  for account authentication, online search, fact checking, and long-running research tasks

summary: Conversational AI research assistant that runs guided research workflows with evidence review, fact checking, and Markdown deliverables in the vault.
